presentation.description:
A plugin to make improvements to the in-game friend system. Includes a client to communicate with the GoodFriend API to send & receive notifications with your friends.

Features:
- Private in design, no identifying information is ever sent about you over the network.
- Send & recieve notifications when your friends login and logout*.
- Get notified when your friends use the world visit system.
- Lots of filtering options for various events.

 * Requires friends to also have GoodFriend installed.
presentation.summary: Improvements to the in-game friend system! Send & receive login and logout notifications with friends and more!

search.website_text:
A Dalamud plugin & web-API that provides improved in-game social functionality
### GoodFriend A Dalamud plugin & associated web-API that provides improved in-game social functionality [![Plugin Downloads](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://dalamud-dl-count.blooym.workers.dev/GoodFriend&label=Plugin%20Downloads)](https://github.com/Blooym/Dalamud.GoodFriend) [![Crowdin Localization](https://badges.crowdin.net/goodfriend/localized.svg)](https://crowdin.com/project/goodfriend) [![Licence](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Blooym/Dalamud.GoodFriend?color=blue&label=Licence)](https://github.com/Blooym/Dalamud.GoodFriend/blob/main/LICENSE) **[Issues](https://github.com/Blooym/Dalamud.GoodFriend/issues) · [Pull Requests](https://github.com/Blooym/Dalamud.GoodFriend/pulls) · [Releases](https://github.com/Blooym/Dalamud.GoodFriend/releases/latest)**
--- ## About GoodFriend is divided into three components: - [Plugin](./src/Plugin): Interacts with the API on behalf of the user and automatically handles any game interactions. - [Client](./src/Client): Client library that wraps API calls and includes things like a stream client and automatic request serialization/deserialization. - [API](./src/Api): Web API that manages the actual communication between clients, as well as various other tasks. ### Drawbacks Due to the nature of the implementation, only users with the plugin installed can send and receive events with the API, as the plugin is responsible for handling the actual event sending and receiving. This means that if you have the plugin installed but your friend does not, any functionality that depends on receiving data from them will not work. Unfortunately, the only way to address this is to ask your friends to install GoodFriend. ## Translation & Localization If you want to contribute localizations to this project please visit GoodFriends's [Crowdin page](https://crwd.in/goodfriend).

variant.author: Blooym
variant.description:
Key Features:
- Receive notifications when friends using GoodFriend log in or out.
- Chat messages show how many of your friends are online when you log in.

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.

I've rewritten GoodFriend from scratch!_

**:warning: Please note that upon updating to the new version, your configuration will be completely wiped as it is no longer compatible. You will also be unable to send events or receive events with your friends using the older version.**

## What's changed?

A new modular design has been used when rewriting so that new functionality can be added in the future with less development work. All the existing functionality of the plugin has been re-implemented already so you shouldn't notice anything missing.

Thanks to this new design, you can now toggle each module on/off independently so that you only have the functionality that you actually want to have.

The interface has also been completely redesigned to clearly show each module as well as plugin-wide configuration options. At the very least, I think it looks better (I'm not a UI/UX designer)

### New Modules

- Login State Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list log in or log out with customizable filtering to only catch the notifications you want to see. (As this is the old functionality of the plugin this module has been enabled by default)

- World Change Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list change worlds using the world visit system while logged in with filtering to only see when people visit your own world (Disabled by default, still being improved as of now)

### Bug Fixes

- Too many to list here, but most of the fixes are related to connectivity problems.

Let me know what you think in either the `#plugin-testing` channel or the GoodFriend plugin thread! Thanks in advance to the plugin reviewers that have to review this as well.
